title.en: Chapter 28 — A Face in the Dark

sentences.ar: مشى توم بممر، والخيط بيخلص، ورجع.
sentences.en: Tom went down a passage, the string ran out, and he came back.
And down a second passage, and came back.
And in the third passage, he saw a light.
A small light, far off, moving.
And his heart leapt, and he shouted: here!
We are here!
And the light stopped, and came near, and turned the corner.
And Tom saw the face behind the candle.
Injun Joe.

sentences.ar: واقف بالعتمة، والشمعة بإيده، ووجهه يلمع.
sentences.en: Standing in the dark, the candle in his hand, his face shining.

sentences.ar: وتوم وقف مكانه، ما بيقدر يتحرك، ولا يتنفس.
sentences.en: And Tom stood where he was, unable to move, or breathe.

sentences.ar: وجو الهندي تطلع بالعتمة، باتجاه الصوت.
sentences.en: And Injun Joe looked into the dark, toward the sound.
And then he turned, and ran, and vanished.
He was afraid.
Injun Joe afraid.

sentences.ar: لأنه ما عرف مين اللي صرخ، وبالمغارة، الصوت بيخوف كل واحد.
sentences.en: Because he did not know who had shouted, and in the cave, a voice frightens everyone.

sentences.ar: رجع توم لبيكي على الخيط، وما حكى لها.
sentences.en: Tom went back to Becky along the string, and did not tell her.
He said: I found nothing.
I will try once more.

sentences.ar: وبيكي كانت صارت ضعيفة، وما بتحكي كتير.
sentences.en: And Becky had grown weak, and did not talk much.

sentences.ar: قالت: توم، إذا مت، خليك جنبي.
sentences.en: She said: Tom, if I die, stay beside me.
And Tom said: you will not die.
And he went.

sentences.ar: وهالمرة، أخد ممر رابع، ما جربه.
sentences.en: And this time, he took a fourth passage, one he had not tried.
And he walked, and walked, and the string ran out.
And at the end of the string, he saw something.
Not candlelight.
Another light.
Grey, far off, and steady.
He left the string, and crawled toward it.

sentences.ar: وكان شق بالصخر، زغير، قد ما يمرق ولد.
sentences.en: And it was a crack in the rock, small, just enough for a boy to pass.
And he came out of it, and fell onto grass.

sentences.ar: وفوقه السما، والنهر تحته، والشمس عم تغيب.
sentences.en: And above him the sky, the river below, the sun setting.

sentences.ar: وبكى توم، لأول مرة من يومين.
sentences.en: And Tom cried, for the first time in two days.
